note: Graveborn Risen (unit identity, Graveborn): a stooped, shambling dead man, torso leaning 15 degrees and arms forward: a rusted coif with a violet brow cord over a grey-green face with soul-lit sunk eyes and a slack jaw, a rust-eaten hauberk torn open over bare ribs, a ragged mail skirt in strips, a torn plate pauldron with a snapped bone shard, violet-bound wrists and ankles and a shredded team tabard hanging in strips. He carries the notched sword in the right hand. Tier II: salvaged plate with violet piping; tier III: black gilt-chased plate, a slitted visor and a team half-cape. No back flag.
